title: fetch_peer_blob rebuilds HTTPS client on every call
description: In peer_fetch.rs::fetch_peer_blob (line 360), build_tailnet_https_client() is called on every invocation. This creates a new rustls::ClientConfig, HttpsConnector, and Hyper Client with a fresh connection pool on every blob fetch. No TCP/TLS connection reuse is possible across sequential or concurrent blob downloads from the same peer. For a message with multiple attachments, each blob fetch incurs a full TLS handshake. The client should be built once (e.g. held in AppState or passed in) and shared across calls. build_probe_client() in discovery.rs already demonstrates the shared-client pattern.
